descriptions.text: Master Pen Key. Opens the individual cages of both the fighters and the bait animals within the kobold fighting pits. This key is magically attuned to the kobold race. If you are not a kobold and attempt to use this key, it will only work once before breaking. Choose wisely.

recap.text: Carl finds the key on the kobold who pressed the button, and it opens one cage in a line of ten. Donut gasps at the last cage, a red-tagged, pink-feathered mongoliensis, though Carl would rather take the brindle grub. A pet biscuit bounces off its blue forcefield, and with thirty seconds left, Carl sighs and jams the key into that lock. The little bastard shoots out, and he grabs it in both hands.

beats.headline: Choose wisely, says the key
beats.text: Picking through the slagged kobolds, Carl finds that the one who pressed the button to open the cages also had a key. It opens the individual cages of the fighters and the bait animals in the kobold fighting pits; for anyone but a kobold it works once and breaks. Past a dirt arena stained red and a pile of bones as tall as the ceiling, a line of ten cages waits, and the room announces itself as a pet reward room. Its reward: you have a key, and it opens only one cage.
beats.gist: Carl finds a key on the kobold who opened the cages; it opens one cage.

beats.headline: The last cage
beats.text: Donut claims the choice and gasps at the very last cage: a pink-feathered chicken dinosaur thing, a red-tagged mongoliensis. Carl thinks it looks like dinner and would rather take the brindle grub. A pet biscuit tossed at its cage bounces off a blue forcefield. Warning: the cages will permanently close in thirty seconds. Donut begs. Carl sighs, takes the key, and jams it into the lock of the mongoliensis cage. The little bastard shoots out, and he grabs it in both hands.
beats.gist: Donut demands the last cage's pink mongoliensis, and Carl, with thirty seconds left, unlocks it and grabs it.
